title: Project Manager
description:
Crossing Hurdles (Samvedh Grow Private Limited) is one of the world's largest suppliers of AI training talent. We build and run expert contributor teams for global AI labs and data companies, with 50,000+ candidates on our network and 1,000+ roles delivered. We are hiring a Project Manager to own AI delivery engagements end to end: the client on one side, the delivery pod on the other, and the performance numbers in between.

Excellent written English; client communication in this role is almost entirely written. Advanced MS Excel or Google Sheets. Exposure to SQL, Python or any BI tool is a plus. Composure under escalation and the judgement to push back on a client with reasoning. Preferred, not mandatory: willingness to work a split shift, approximately half the day in Indian business hours and a reserved evening or night block for US client calls and coordination.
